# Test Fixtures

`sample_utterance.wav` is a **synthetic** fixture (two sine-wave tone bursts
separated by silence), not real speech -- generated by `generate_fixture.py`.
See that script's docstring for why: no vetted-license real Hindi audio
source and no offline Hindi TTS engine were available in this build
environment. It's sufficient to test VAD segmentation and the
partial/final event pipeline; it is *not* used for ASR accuracy/WER
evaluation (that requires real speech and belongs in
`scripts/model-eval/`, per `docs/BLUEPRINT.md` Section 11.3 -- deferred
until a real gold-set fixture is sourced).
